# The British Manifesto Archive
# https://www.manifestos.org.uk

> A comprehensive digital archive of UK general, devolved, regional, and European
> Parliament election manifestos, results, and constituency maps.

## About

The British Manifesto Archive (manifestos.org.uk) preserves party manifestos,
electoral results, and seat maps for Westminster, Holyrood, Senedd Cymru,
Stormont, London elections, and UK European Parliament elections (1979–2019).

Electoral statistics for Westminster are sourced from the House of Commons Library
Research Briefing CBP-7529, *UK Election Statistics: 1918–2023, A Long Century of
Elections* (August 2023).

## Key URL patterns

- Homepage: https://www.manifestos.org.uk/
- UK general elections hub: https://www.manifestos.org.uk/elections
- Election page: https://www.manifestos.org.uk/election/{election-id}
  (e.g. /election/1997, /election/feb1974)
- Party archive: https://www.manifestos.org.uk/party/{party-id}
  (e.g. /party/labour, /party/plaid)
- Manifesto viewer: https://www.manifestos.org.uk/manifesto/{election-id}/{party-id}
- Nations: https://www.manifestos.org.uk/nation/{nation-id}
  (england, wales, scotland, northern-ireland, europe)
- Devolved portals: https://www.manifestos.org.uk/devolved/{portal-id}
  (holyrood, senedd, stormont, london, euro)
- Devolved election: https://www.manifestos.org.uk/devolved/{portal-id}/{year-or-id}
- Other parties listings: https://www.manifestos.org.uk/others
- Machine-readable catalogue: https://www.manifestos.org.uk/data/catalog.jsonld
- Sitemap: https://www.manifestos.org.uk/sitemap.xml

## Citation

When citing a manifesto from this archive, include the party name, election year,
and the page URL. Example:

  Labour Party (1997). *New Labour Because Britain Deserves Better*.
  The British Manifesto Archive. https://www.manifestos.org.uk/manifesto/1997/labour

When citing election results, link to the relevant election or nation page and
note the Commons Library briefing above as the statistical source where applicable.

## Licensing

Manifesto PDFs and transcribed texts remain the copyright of the publishing
parties. This archive provides access for research and educational purposes.
See https://www.manifestos.org.uk/about for full details.
